findings.summary: Row still lists scheduling the outbox and cron.job_run_details prune as open work; migration 0023 now does it, so the handover overstates what remains; mark it done or reword to the staging cron-drain check only

broadcastTopic calls JSON.parse on every text frame from the Realtime server with no guard; a non-JSON text frame would throw inside the onMessage handler and stall the proxied socket; wrap in try/catch and forward unparsed frames [Resolved: try/catch returns null, frame forwarded]

Unbatched DELETE with no index on consumed_at: seq scan plus one transaction per day; fine at current volume and documented with a revisit threshold (about 1M rows); first run after a long gap is the largest

The 1 s visibility timeout for the toast is tight on a loaded 3-worker run, but it deliberately asserts the toast outlives the feed remount (about 4 s lifetime); keep unless it flakes in the three-run gate

useShowComposerToast throws if a composer ever renders outside app/(app); today every consumer is inside it (verified), so the throw is a clear guard, but a future use under app/admin or (public) crashes the page instead of degrading
